limitations_and_boundaries: No negative results or failure cases are reported for fine-tuning tasks beyond the comparison to alternative methods.
The absence of a rescue experiment (e.g., overexpression of a predicted target reversing the effect) is noted.
It is not specified whether the fine-tuning hyperparameters were optimal for each task; the authors note that hyperparameter tuning would likely improve performance.
Causal relationships are not fully established; only correlations and perturbation effects are reported.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Can a pretrained deep learning model, Geneformer, leverage transfer learning to enable context-specific predictions in network biology with limited data?

claims.statement: CRISPR-mediated knockout of TEAD4 in iPSC-derived cardiac microtissues causes a significant reduction in contractile stress.

provenance.text_excerpt: CRISPR-mediated knockout of both Geneformer-predicted targets GSN and PLN in the TTN+/− cells significantly improved the contractile stress of the TTN+/− cardiac microtissues

claims.statement: CRISPR-mediated knockout of GSN and PLN in TTN+/− cardiac microtissues significantly improves contractile stress, validating them as therapeutic targets for dilated cardiomyopathy.

experiments_or_tasks: Fine-tuned Geneformer to classify single-nucleus RNA-seq data from non-failing, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and dilated cardiomyopathy hearts into disease states.

Fine-tuned Geneformer to distinguish central versus peripheral factors within the NOTCH1-dependent gene network using single-cell transcriptional data from about 30,000 normal endothelial cells from the Heart Atlas.
Fine-tuned Geneformer to distinguish NOTCH1 downstream targets from non-targets using the same data.

Performed in silico perturbation (deletion/activation) to identify genes whose perturbation shifts cell embeddings toward disease states (disease modeling) or toward non-failing state (in silico treatment).

methods.name: In silico perturbation
methods.protocol_description: For each gene, the model's input is modified to simulate deletion (removing gene from top 2048) or activation (duplicating gene). The effect on cell embeddings is measured via cosine similarity. Disease modeling: identify genes whose in silico perturbation in non-failing cells shifts embeddings toward disease state. In silico treatment: identify genes whose perturbation in disease cells shifts embeddings toward non-failing.

During pretraining, Geneformer gained a fundamental understanding of network dynamics, encoding network hierarchy in the attention weights of the model in a completely self-supervised manner.

claims.statement: Geneformer encodes network hierarchy in its attention weights in a completely self-supervised manner during pretraining.

datasets.name: Genecorpus-30M

evidence_spans.content: Geneformer is a context-aware, attention-based deep learning model pretrained on large-scale transcriptomic data to enable predictions in network biology with limited data through transfer learning.

provenance.text_excerpt: Geneformer is a context-aware, attention-based deep learning model pretrained on large-scale transcriptomic data to enable predictions in network biology with limited data through transfer learning.

experiments_or_tasks: Pretrained Geneformer on Genecorpus-30M using a self-supervised masked learning objective.

methods.name: Geneformer pretraining
methods.protocol_description: Geneformer is a context-aware, attention-based deep learning model with six layers of transformer encoder units, input size 2048, 256 embedding dimensions, four attention heads, feed-forward size 512, ReLU activation, dropout 0.02, trained with masked learning objective (15% masked), max learning rate 1e-3, linear warmup, Adam with weight decay fix, warmup steps 10000, weight decay 0.001, batch size 12, three epochs. Optimized with dynamic length-grouped padding (29.4x speedup) and Deepspeed distributed GPU training (12 V100 GPUs, ~3 days).

methods.name: Geneformer fine-tuning
methods.protocol_description: Initialized with pretrained Geneformer weights, added a final task-specific transformer layer. Fine-tuning hyperparameters: max learning rate 5e-5, linear warmup, Adam with weight decay fix, warmup steps 500, weight decay 0.001, batch size 12, single epoch. Number of frozen layers varied per task.
